summary.text: Pauline Wendzel is a Republican state representative from Michigan House District 39 who has held a seat in the Michigan House since 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She chairs the House Energy Committee.

paragraphs.text: Pauline Wendzel graduated from Watervliet High School and earned a B.A. in anthropology and food industry marketing from Michigan State University.

Her career experience includes working as the product brand development manager with Coloma Frozen Foods, the programs director of North Berrien Historical Museum, and a counselor with Five Pines Christian Day Camp.
Wendzel's tenure in the Michigan House began in 2019, and she has represented District 39 since January 1, 2023.

She advanced from the Republican primary on August 4, 2026; in the 2025-2026 session she chairs the Energy Committee and also sits on the Communications and Technology, House Regulatory Reform, Rules and Competitiveness, and Select Committee on Protecting Michigan Employees and Small Businesses committees.
